endpoints.description: Token liquidity and momentum snapshot, half a cent: live DEX liquidity in USD, price, market cap, pair age, 1h/24h volume, buy-vs-sell transaction ratio, price change — the raw DexScreener read for any EVM token, one source, no fusion. Base, Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism, Avalanche. Cheapest pre-trade depth check; upgrade to /api/evmtoken ($0.015) for the fused safety verdict or /api/exit-depth for sell-impact modeling.

Search public classified listings by market area, category, query, and common marketplace filters; returns normalized posting titles, prices, locations, dates, and ids without exposing collection URLs.

city.description: Market area id, such as sfbay, newyork, losangeles, seattle, chicago, or boston.

sort.description: Sort filter for Classified Listing Search. Accepted values: "date", "rel", "priceasc", "pricedsc". Constraints: accepted values: "date", "rel", "priceasc", "pricedsc"; default: "date".

limit.description: Limit numeric value for Classified Listing Search. Constraints: default: 25; min: 1; max: 100.

hasPic.description: Set true to enable has pic behavior for Classified Listing Search.

postal.description: Optional postal code to force geo-scoping when the caller's IP region differs from the target city.

category.description: Listing category abbreviation, such as sss, cta, apa, jjj, or zip.

max_price.description: Max price numeric value for Classified Listing Search. Constraints: min: 0.

min_price.description: Min price numeric value for Classified Listing Search. Constraints: min: 0.

pool.description: Optional pool preference. mobile maps to the Proxies.sx mbl pool, residential maps to peer, and any lets the gateway choose.

reason.description: Optional caller note for internal observability, such as blocked-direct-worker-egress.

country.description: Two-letter country code for the Proxies.sx pool, for example US.

enabled.description: Set false to force direct Worker egress when service-level Proxies.sx default routing is enabled.

session.description: Optional sticky-session key. Use stable, non-secret text when you need repeated calls to keep the same mobile identity.

rotation.description: Rotation mode requested from the runner. sticky keeps the same session; hard asks for a fresh mobile IP.

proxiesSx.description: Optional Proxies.sx egress hint for services that need mobile/residential fetches. Pass true for default US mobile egress, or an object with enabled, country, session, and rotation. Credentials and proxy URLs are never accepted from callers.

max_bedrooms.description: Max bedrooms numeric value for Classified Listing Search. Constraints: min: 0.

min_bedrooms.description: Min bedrooms numeric value for Classified Listing Search. Constraints: min: 0.

search_distance.description: Optional radius in miles when postal is supplied.

bundleDuplicates.description: Set true to enable bundle duplicates behavior for Classified Listing Search.

endpoints.description: Find public rental listings by market resource id, rental category, price, bedrooms, bathrooms, and result limit; returns normalized rental/building records without collection links.

limit.description: Limit numeric value for Rental Listing Search. Constraints: default: 25; min: 1; max: 100.

orderBy.description: Order By filter for Rental Listing Search. Accepted values: "score", "recencyTime", "price". Constraints: accepted values: "score", "recencyTime", "price"; default: "score".

maxPrice.description: Max Price numeric value for Rental Listing Search. Constraints: min: 0.

minPrice.description: Min Price numeric value for Rental Listing Search. Constraints: min: 0.

pool.description: Optional pool preference. mobile maps to the Proxies.sx mbl pool, residential maps to peer, and any lets the gateway choose.

reason.description: Optional caller note for internal observability, such as blocked-direct-worker-egress.

country.description: Two-letter country code for the Proxies.sx pool, for example US.

enabled.description: Set false to force direct Worker egress when service-level Proxies.sx default routing is enabled.

session.description: Optional sticky-session key. Use stable, non-secret text when you need repeated calls to keep the same mobile identity.

rotation.description: Rotation mode requested from the runner. sticky keeps the same session; hard asks for a fresh mobile IP.

proxiesSx.description: Optional Proxies.sx egress hint for services that need mobile/residential fetches. Pass true for default US mobile egress, or an object with enabled, country, session, and rotation. Credentials and proxy URLs are never accepted from callers.

resourceId.description: Market resource slug or id, such as san-francisco-ca, new-york-ny, brooklyn-new-york-ny, or 94110-ca.

searchSlug.description: Rental search slug, such as apartments-for-rent, houses-for-rent, condos-for-rent, townhomes-for-rent, or rooms-for-rent.
